caption: SASL_SCRAM proves who the client is; SSL encrypts everything on the wire. The password comes from an env var, never hardcoded.

kafka-acls.sh --bootstrap-server broker:9092 \
  --add --allow-principal User:orders-producer \
  --operation Write --topic orders

kafka-acls.sh --bootstrap-server broker:9092 \
  --add --allow-principal User:orders-consumer \
  --operation Read --topic orders --group orders-processor
caption: orders-producer can only write; orders-consumer can only read, as that one specific group.
